page_title: VER 2-1 VEN | Verona v Venezia 04/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Marco Guida has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) for his blatant foul.
90+2' John Yeboah (Venezia) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Lorenzo Montipo is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
90+2' Verona take a short corner kick.

90+2' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Verona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' That's the end of the game for Daniele Ghilardi, who is replaced by Yllan Okou (Verona).
89' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Casper Tengstedt will be replaced by Diego Coppola (Verona).
87' John Yeboah (Venezia) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
86' Ball possession – 56:44.
85' A substitution has been made. Marin Sverko is replaced by Antonio Raimondo (Venezia).
81' 2 - 1 Jesse Joronen (Venezia) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
81' The referee awards a corner and Darko Lazovic (Verona) goes over to take it.
81' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. Verona have a corner.
80' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
80' Darko Lazovic (Verona) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
80' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dani Silva (Verona) replacing Ondrej Duda.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dailon Rocha Livramento leaves the pitch and Amin Sarr (Verona) comes on.
76' Ondrej Duda (Verona) has received a yellow card for his foul.
76' John Yeboah (Venezia) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
75' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:2.
73' Here is a change. Gaetano Oristanio is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to John Yeboah (Venezia).
73' The game has come to an end for Joel Pohjanpalo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).

70' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
70' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Casper Tengstedt (Verona).
69' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Verona comes to nothing.

68' Ondrej Duda (Verona) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Jesse Joronen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.

67' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) leaps to meet the corner, but fires his header back across goal from close in and it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
67' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) will take a corner kick.
65' It will be a substitution. Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) is ready to enter the pitch as Daniel Mosquera walks off.
65' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
64' Antonio Candela (Venezia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Venezia.
61' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Issa Doumbia.
61' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Ridgeciano Haps and he is replaced by Francesco Zampano (Venezia).

61' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
59' The ball possession at the moment is 55:45.

56' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
56' Darko Lazovic (Verona) brings an opponent down and Marco Guida interrupts the game.
55' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Verona earn a corner.
54' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
52' The corner finds Reda Belahyane (Verona) unmarked but his close-range header is poor and slips well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
51' Ondrej Duda (Verona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
51' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.

48' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
48' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

43' Antonio Candela (Venezia) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
43' A corner kick by Venezia is thwarted by the well prepared Lorenzo Montipo (Verona).

39' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Daniel Mosquera (Verona) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
39' Ondrej Duda (Verona) prepares to take a corner kick.
38' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Verona force their opponents to concede a corner.
36' Venezia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
36' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:4.
33' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Jesse Joronen comes off his line to gather the ball.
31' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
31' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
31' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Venezia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

27' What a big chance! Daniel Mosquera (Verona) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
26' Issa Doumbia (Venezia) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
24' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Darko Lazovic (Verona) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
24' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) makes a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
21' That's unlucky! Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
21' Yellow card. Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
20' A dangerous looking corner kick from Darko Lazovic (Verona) is cleared to safety by the defence.
20' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Verona.
19' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Verona will have a corner.
18' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
17' Ondrej Duda (Verona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
15' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
13' Ondrej Duda (Verona) works the corner short.
13' Darko Lazovic (Verona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
13' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
11' Michael Svoboda (Venezia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
11' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

11' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) sends a wild header high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
10' Ondrej Duda (Verona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

10' Excellent touch by Casper Tengstedt (Verona)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save. Verona win a corner.
9' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Daniel Mosquera laid the ball off to Casper Tengstedt (Verona), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
8' Ondrej Duda (Verona) launches a cross from the corner, but Jesse Joronen is alert to thwart the effort.
8' Reda Belahyane (Verona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Verona.
7' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece.

5' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Darko Lazovic (Verona), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.

2' 0 - 1 Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:1.
2' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) will deliver the corner kick.
2' Venezia fail to score from a corner as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaps to collect the ball. Venezia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Venezia will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Guida.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
